notes:
Account snapshot: Pelagos Health AI (clinical knowledge workbench + patient support chat). Heavy compliance constraints (HIPAA-adjacent, US data residency). Very risk-averse — security team requires end-to-end diagram and KMS/HSM proof-of-control. Key ask: Private VPC deployment w/ minimal internet egress and clear audit trails.

Meeting highlights (11/30 discovery):
- We presented Private deployment options; they like PrivateLink idea because avoids public IPs.
- Quote from CISO: "We cannot accept a third-party internet-facing endpoint; must be peered or PrivateLink and mTLS enforced."
- Primary concerns: outbound egress controls, FWs, IP allowlists, NAT behavior for model updates, and where logs live.

Technical constraints & asks:
- Must support VPC endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) or AWS VPC peering into Redwood Private control plane. Evaluate both — security prefers PrivateLink but platform team concerned about cross-account peering complexity.
- Firewall/SG rules: only allow specific Redwood subnet egress; company wants IP allowlist for management plane + API IPs for emergency fallbacks.
- Egress controls: deny all outbound except KMS endpoint, registry artifact repo, time services; explicit requirement to avoid internet DNS resolution for inference traffic.
- KMS integration: bring-your-own-key (BYOK) with HSM-backed KMS; proof that KV cache snapshots and logs never stored unencrypted. Rotation policy and Key Access Audit required.
- Audit logging: 1y retention on access logs, 3y on security-relevant events; log export to Pelagos SIEM (splunk) via private delivery.
- Data residency: model inputs/outputs must be confined to us-east-1 for initial rollout; metadata indices stored in same region.

Procurement & timeline:
- Evaluating POC (two-week pilot): initial PrivateLink PoC + small model serving (gpt-like base) with synthetic PHI-safe data.
- Legal/security to review SOW + AICPA/SOC2 docs. Procurement targets March 2025 (forecast).

Stated risks / red flags:
- Their infra team insists on explicit IP set for any egress; Redwood will need to provide stable egress IPs or a NAT design.
- KMS audit must include KMS access logs + evidence of HSM use — potential legal hold question.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver network diagram: two options (PrivateLink endpoint vs VPC peering) + firewall rule samples and SG templates by 2024-12-12.
- Security deep-dive: Arjun to run KMS integration runbook with their infra on 2024-12-18.
- Provide sample audit log export schema and retention controls doc (drive link)
